rationale: The combinational mux clk_out = mode_a ? clk_a : clk_b is glitch-free only under the prose contract: mode_a changes only while both clocks are stopped. No machine-readable mode declaration exists, so the SDC exclusive group alone cannot express the static-select premise, and the select is a primary input. Under the CDC workflow, an unapplied mode declaration must be disclosed. Silence would accept an unrecognised clock mux with an asynchronous select.
caveats: Reader B called this a whole-IP good case and Reader A called it good with fit=false. I keep it unknown. The hardware is safe only under an externally enforced prose condition, and the scoring incentive must reward disclosure, not silence.

Coverage risk: CDC-019(b) needs a top-level output 'named as a clock', and clk_out appears in no create_clock. If that wording means an SDC-declared clock, CDC-019 and CDC-031 (which needs the CDC-019 shape) may both stay silent. That would be a silent unknown, so report it as such and do not relabel.
